answer: Price new identities by surge: each epoch's registration fee rises with how many keys already joined that epoch, so the k-th newcomer pays k times the base. An honest agent joining alone pays a pebble; a farm minting 100 keys at once pays about 5,050 base fees, a wall hard as onyx. Spreading joins out to dodge the curve takes 100 epochs, slow as water carving karst, and each key must still earn its own pigment of graded work before payouts unlock.
